overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance data reveals clear audience preference for space exploration, extreme planetary physics, and high-stakes 'What If' scenarios. Specifically, videos covering exotic astronomical phenomena and unusual planetary conditions (such as liquid diamond planets, extreme dark worlds, and orbital anomalies) achieve significantly higher view counts and engagement ratios (likes-per-view) compared to general psychological tricks or standard biological facts. Recent uploads from late September and early October 2026 (e.g., Venus's day/year anomaly, liquid diamond planet scenarios, and dark exoplanets) are outperforming older generic content, proving that speculative astrophysical visualization combined with immediate curiosity gaps drives the strongest traction.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Darkest Planet?' (YlDuGu1vzAg) generated strong engagement (1,029 and 828 views respectively with high like counts), outperforming standard historical or psychological facts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on high-concept astrophysical 'What If' scenarios featuring exotic matter, extreme gravity, or bizarre planetary surfaces.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles like 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year 🤯' (A9Qa-RmuOr0) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b 🌌' (v1rrcZLdp4U) quickly accumulated ~1,000 views and healthy engagement ratios within a short timeframe.
winning_patterns.action: Continue framing space facts around baffling physics paradoxes that defy normal human intuition.

weak_patterns.evidence: Shorts centered on memory formation ('Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories', views as low as 5 to 53) and song earworms showed consistently weak velocity and lower engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize psychological tips and memory micro-facts unless paired with a high-intensity neurological mystery or AI-driven angle.

weak_patterns.evidence: Basic animal facts like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (when repeated or straightforwardly presented without a fresh narrative twist) saw stagnant growth compared to deep-space content.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid standard textbook trivia; if covering animals, pivot to cinematic animal survival or extreme prehistoric comparisons.
